items.source: Overloaded variant of send(Object) that also accepts a MediaType hint for how to serialize the given Object.

items.source: IOException - raised when an I/O error occurs
items.translation: IOException - 在发生 I/O 错误时抛出

items.source: object - the object to write
items.translation: object - 要写入的对象

items.source: While DeferredResult is used to produce a single result, a ResponseBodyEmitter can be used to send multiple objects where each object is written with a compatible HttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 虽然 `DeferredResult` 用于生成单个结果，但可以使用 `ResponseBodyEmitter` 发送多个对象，其中每个对象都由兼容的 `HttpMessageConverter` 写入。

items.source: Note: if the send fails with an IOException, you do not need to call completeWithError(Throwable) in order to clean up. Instead the Servlet container creates a notification that results in a dispatch where Spring MVC invokes exception resolvers and completes processing.
items.translation: 注意：如果发送操作因 IOException 失败，则无需调用 completeWithError(Throwable) 来进行清理。相反，Servlet 容器会创建一个通知，导致进行分发，此时 Spring MVC 将调用异常解析器并完成处理。

items.source: Note: this method should be called by the application to complete request processing. It should not be used after container related events such as an error while sending.
items.translation: 注意：此方法应由应用程序调用以完成请求处理。在容器相关事件（例如在sending期间发生错误）之后，不应使用此方法。

items.source: Note: this method should be called by the application to complete request processing with an error. It should not be used after container related events such as an error while sending.
items.translation: 注意： 此方法应由应用程序调用，以在发生错误时完成请求处理。它不应在容器相关事件（例如在发送过程中出错）之后使用。

items.source: Supported as a return type on its own as well as within a ResponseEntity.
items.translation: 作为返回类型单独支持，也支持在 ResponseEntity 中。

items.source: Compared to send(Object, MediaType), this batches the write operations and flushes to the network at the end.
items.translation: 与send(Object, MediaType)相比，此方法将写入操作批处理，并在最后刷新到网络。

items.source:
If any exception occurs a dispatch is made back to the app server where
Spring MVC will pass the exception through its exception handling mechanism.
items.translation: 如果发生任何异常，将向应用服务器发起一次分派，Spring MVC 将通过其异常处理机制传递该异常。

items.source:
A dispatch is made into the app server where Spring MVC will pass the
exception through its exception handling mechanism. Note however that
at this stage of request processing, the response is committed and the
response status can no longer be changed.
items.translation: 请求被分发到应用服务器，Spring MVC 将通过其异常处理机制传递该异常。但请注意，在此请求处理阶段，响应已提交，因此无法再更改响应状态。
